notes.title: The Los Palmus Update Is Here
notes.content:
[h2]The Los Palmus Update Just Launched![/h2]
[h3]The biggest update since the game's release is now available![/h3]

[b]Here's what's new:[/b]

[list]
[*] 10 additional days of main story content

[*] New characters and stories

[*] A brand new cleaning store

[*] Dozens of new items to clean

[*] An all-new Sandbox Mode — clean any item in the game with no restrictions

[*] Various bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements
[/list]

Try it now for free!

notes.title: Toggled Cleaning
notes.content:
While the new content update is in progress, toggled cleaning has now been added to the game settings menu :)

To toggle the cleaning control instead of holding the cleaning button:

1. Enable the toggle cleaning in the game settings under controls.
2. Press the cleaning button (LMB) to enable the cleaning toggle.
3. Press the cleaning button (LMB) again to disable the cleaning toggle.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
After many requests, finally, [b]Steam achievements[/b] are now available in Clean It Up!

From selling high to finishing the game as fast as you can, there are now a total of 14 new achievements for players to get, with a secret achievement for players who try to cheat the system ;)

In addition to the Steam achievements integration, small bugs and problems discovered by the community are now fixed!
